workItem: Host the existing pinned Google Analytics MCP read plane inside the Finance Render runtime and expose only an owner-only cached read projection, without Codex or GitHub runner execution.
workItemDE: Die bestehende gepinnte Google-Analytics-MCP-Read-Plane innerhalb der Finance-Render-Runtime hosten und ausschließlich als Owner-only gecachte Read-Projektion bereitstellen, ohne Codex- oder GitHub-Runner-Ausführung.
scopeBoundary: Reuse analytics-mcp==0.7.0 as the sole GA4 MCP provider implementation; do not create a second Google Analytics API client or write plane.
Run analytics-mcp as an internal stdio child process of the existing Finance Render runtime; do not expose a public raw MCP endpoint.
Allow only get_account_summaries, get_property_details, run_realtime_report and run_report.
Owner-only HTTP projection protected by the existing checkAdminAccess IAM boundary.
Service-account JSON stays server-side, is materialized only into the runtime-private temp directory with mode 0600 and is never returned or logged.
Provider projection is cached for five minutes and performs no Google Analytics mutation.
Codex and GitHub Actions are not execution hosts for GA4 after Render cutover.
exitEvidence: Fresh CURRENT_MAIN is an ancestor of the exact branch head.
Focused tests prove allowlisted MCP calls, property binding, cache behavior, owner-only route wiring and secret non-projection.
Production Docker image contains the pinned analytics-mcp==0.7.0 runtime and no runtime package download is required.
Render manifest declares only GA4 secret/config key names and never credential values.
No unresolved writer/file/semantic overlap remains before PR creation.
Human/CODEOWNER merge remains required for the production-runtime/container change.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
